name: Camino de Santiago del Estrecho
description_md:
The Camino de Santiago del Estrecho is a waymarked hiking route in Spain. It spans 147.9 km with 1900 m of ascent and 1911 m of descent.

The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, requiring about 42 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. This trail belongs to the national waymarked hiking network. The route passes Castillo de Santa Catalina within 100 m, Puerta de Jerez within 200 m, and the Battle of Rio Salado within 1200 m.
